I am so sorry you are experiencing emotional abuse from your dad. It is completely understandable that you feel angry in such a painful situation, and please know you do not deserve to be treated this way. Because you are dealing with abuse, your safety is the top priority. I strongly encourage you to reach out to the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-SAFE (text "START" to 88788) or the Crisis Text Line (text HOME to 741741) for confidential support and safety planning. 

When trying to manage your temper in the moment, the safest approach is often to disengage. Try keeping your responses as brief and neutral as possible to avoid feeding into his behavior. If you feel your anger rising, give yourself permission to physically step away from the conversation, even if you must make an excuse like needing to use the restroom. Taking slow, deep breaths in a separate room can help ground you until you can safely exit the interaction.
